parameters: A gate older than the house above it. Cut deep into the stone: a rose, growing round a sun.
Four words ring the seal, cut in order: KNEEL. SWEAR. PLANT. KINDLE.
The seal is cold and dark.
The rose round the sun burns blue. The seal hums - not unkindly.
As if it remembers a hand like yours.
The carving shows knights kneeling before a figure made only of light.
Below it a single word, worn almost away: "...until."
"First the knight knelt. Then he swore upon the stone.
Then the rose was planted at the door, and the fire kindled to keep it -
"Whoever keeps this door keeps the oath.
Whoever keeps the oath keeps the light."
A cold brazier. On the tablet above it: a knight on one knee, his sword laid down before him.
The flame takes, and burns blue.
The flame flares - and gutters out. Every brazier you lit has gone dark with it.
The flame burns blue and steady under the carving of a knight on one knee, his sword laid down before him.
A cold brazier. On the tablet above it: a bare hand pressed flat to a stone, light running out between the fingers.
The flame takes, and burns blue.
The flame flares - and gutters out. Every brazier you lit has gone dark with it.
The flame burns blue and steady under the carving of a bare hand pressed flat to a stone, light running out between the fingers.
A cold brazier. On the tablet above it: a rose, its roots gripping the stones of a doorway.
The flame takes, and burns blue.
The flame flares - and gutters out. Every brazier you lit has gone dark with it.
The flame burns blue and steady under the carving of a rose, its roots gripping the stones of a doorway.
A cold brazier. On the tablet above it: a fire in a cupped pair of hands, rayed like a small sun.
The flame takes, and burns blue.
Somewhere in the foundations a deep note sounds, like a bell heard under water.
The flame flares - and gutters out. Every brazier you lit has gone dark with it.
The flame burns blue and steady under the carving of a fire in a cupped pair of hands, rayed like a small sun.
